description: California's 4th congressional district consists of all of Colusa, Napa, Sutter, and Yuba Counties, and portions of Lake, Placer, Sacramento, Sonoma and Yolo Counties. Cities in the district include American Canyon, Colusa, Cotati, Davis (partial), Esparto, Hidden Valley Lake (partial), Lincoln, Live Oak, Marysville, Middletown, Napa, Petaluma (partial), Rohnert Park, Sonoma, St. Helena, Williams, Winters, Woodland, Wheatland, and Yuba City.
